description: Production deploy, read-only plan: runs the root-owned csa-prod-deploy entry script as the ubuntu user with the action fixed to plan. Published in AWS as csa-production-plan.

sha.description: Full 40 character lowercase commit sha on main.

pythonDigest.description: Digest of the csa-python image to roll out, sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

frontendDigest.description: Digest of the csa-frontend image to roll out, sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

runCommand: exec runuser -u ubuntu -- /usr/local/sbin/csa-prod-deploy plan "{{ sha }}" "" "" "{{ pythonDigest }}" "{{ frontendDigest }}"
